description: Generic Elasticsearch REST passthrough: any method, any path. Returns {status, body}. A 4xx/5xx answer is returned as an error: "HTTP <status> <type>: <reason>" plus the trimmed body. Use a string body for NDJSON (_bulk, _msearch). On readonly connections only reads pass: GET, HEAD, POST [/<index>]/_search|_msearch|_count|_field_caps|_pit, POST /_search/scroll, DELETE /_pit and /_search/scroll.

path.description: path from the ES root, e.g. '/idx/_search'

name: es_request
